page.name: Ink Line
page.label: "Connect a native A:M model. Choose a group or apply ink to the whole model. Unfilled Splines Only skips segments that form patch edges."

page.name: Quick Profile
page.label: "Enable Vary Width and Color to blend the base settings with middle and end stops along each spline. Position follows the authored control-point spans. Color alpha controls opacity."

page.name: Spline Profile
page.label: "Enable Spline Profile to shape the stroke with Bézier points. Click the curve to add a point, drag its handles to shape the transition, or press Delete to remove a selected point."
"Width is a percentage of the base width. Each Inked Section fits the profile to every continuous run selected by the group and spline scope."
